flags: CDOT gives 236 miles and six hours; archived FHWA gives 233 miles and five hours; material maps 231 miles. Use the route-specific CDOT figure with attribution, not an averaged or hedged distance.
Moments run Silverton, Red Mountain Pass, Ouray, matching increasing strip miles in a Durango-start loop. Telluride is a spur, not a through-road link.
Practical checked date records review of cached CDOT advice, not live verification that the pass is open. No current closure or opening date is asserted.
Removed the current summer/late-September-aspen season prescription: the cache does not establish that timing. Story-level aspens motif retained as required; no foliage claim is made.

The byway page uses Million Dollar Highway for Ouray–Durango, while CDOT identifies Ouray–Silverton. No disputed wider extent is asserted. Silverton and Durango pages also disagree on the railroad sale year, so that year is omitted.
